user_request: Delete the previously generated Chinese synthetic dataset on Windows to save space; user believes Linux may retain a copy.
inventory_method: Read-only filesystem path, type and size enumeration; no data or label records parsed; no reparse points followed.

existing_copy_evidence.scope: Two formal train/development redacted_items.jsonl files plus eight derived projection arrays/row-key files were present with matching sizes and SHA-256 on 2026-09-07. This does not establish that the full dataset roots are currently mirrored.

next_stage.purpose: Verify Linux copies before removing Windows payloads needed to retain old research reproducibility.
next_stage.operations: After user resumes the reported Linux stage, inspect only relevant owned paths, file metadata and necessary SHA-256 values. Return a small inventory; no dataset generation, training, GPU use, remote deletion or environment changes.
next_stage.resources: One low-priority sequential CPU process for hashing at most approximately 7.1 GiB of the three principal dataset roots; streaming memory usage and small metadata transfer; wait if shared storage is busy.
next_stage.missing_copy_disposition: Do not delete a sole necessary research copy. Report missing coverage before any archival transfer; sealed truth is outside this verification stage.

retention.preserve: Existing result reports, reviews, source/generation manifests and necessary reproducibility records.
retention.excluded: models/, real marketplace source inputs, private_custody/, sealed labels/qrels/controller assets, Git object stores and other users' server files.
